name: memory_save
description: Save a lasting fact to long-term memory, or replace the fact with the same name. Use for preferences, routines, people in the home and corrections to your behavior. Not for one-off commands or current device states.

name.description: Unique key in English snake_case, e.g. evening_light. Reuse an existing name to update that fact.

content.description: The fact in one or two sentences, in the user's language.

name: memory_delete
description: Delete a fact from long-term memory when it is wrong or no longer true.

name.description: Name of the fact to delete.
